category: 益智 · 画线物理防护
core_gameplay: Original50-level ball/bee survival, native physics drawing/ink/time/earned coins/skins/achievements retained; actual Level1win andLevel2fail/retry.
core_experience: 快速画线的物理防御解谜，每关约30秒画线+15秒生存
controls: Mouse or original touch drawing, Ready, Next/Retry/Menu/Shop/Achievements; original controls retained.
game_loop: 开始：菜单选PLAY/CONTINUE进关；操作：限时画盾，READY或倒计时结束进入生存阶段，蜂群追踪攻击；结果：存活则BALL SAVED+50币，碰撞则STUNG可重试；继续：NEXT LEVEL/RETRY/MENU
content: 固定50关，10种主题背景每5关切换；6种球皮肤商店购买；6项成就
progression: 过关解锁下一关（localStorage stb_level），首过每关得50币，金币购皮肤，成就给额外金币
save: Original stb_* localStorage, actual Level2/50coins and deduplicated Level1reward preserved after reload.
rules: 目标：保护球15秒内不被蜜蜂碰到；成功：倒计时结束存活，+50币（仅首过）；失败：蜂球碰撞即STUNG；墨量上限1400，画线限时30秒，画线不能穿过球体
systems: 画线系统（拖动采样点生成物理刚体）、蜂群AI（追踪+摆动）、碰撞判定、墨量限制、金币/皮肤/成就经济、主题轮换
ui_flow: 菜单（进度/金币/PLAY/商店/成就/重置）→ 关卡（等级/倒计时/墨量/READY）→ 结算（NEXT/RETRY/MENU）；商店购买装备皮肤；成就弹窗展示进度
level_design: 第1关3只蜂低速，关卡升高蜂数（2+关卡数）与速度递增、生成间隔缩短；蜂巢固定三处

SameLevel1retry win LEVELCLEARED-NOCOINS proves reward dedup. NextLevel2withoutshield actualSTUNG; retry resets30s and normal menu. Original shop50coins/Blue250 rejects withYouNeed200More, remains50. Achievements1/10,39/300survival; reload Level2/50coins restored. Entire original main.js, Phaser3.80.1 and5original image/audio files byte unchanged. Complete original50-level generation/10themes/progression retained, levels3–50 not played; affordable skins/achievement claims and mobile/audio hearing not exhausted. Complete final reload/play/draw/win/retry/fail/shop/achievements/reload window no truncation/external/missing/errors.
